selection: Broad current liquid crypto discovery; investigate no more than 10 and surface no more than 5. No historical outcome access. No calibrated probabilities.
clock_policy: Cutoff fixed before current-market retrieval. Record provider as-of and actual retrieval time separately. Post-cutoff observations excluded from cutoff claims. Undated or stale quotes cannot become frozen current reference prices. This file is a local precommitment, not trusted prospective formation.
